## How it works
The stock plugin already samples the microphone to draw its waveform. This build reuses that reading
: speech crossing an RMS gate accumulates speaking time, then continuous silence calls the same `fin
ish()` the Stop button calls. No provider change: SenseVoice already transcribes a complete clip and
does its own VAD segmentation.
## Compatibility
Built against DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`. The bundle patch targets the stock row id `ui-voice-input`. If a fut
ure DSH release renames that row or changes the client plugin contract, the patch cannot apply and t
he microphone disappears — uninstall to recover. This plugin does not add streaming transcripts.
